def factor_tail_range_vol_of_vol(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    tr = pd.Series(talib.TRANGE(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"]), index=df_copy.index)
    vol_range = tr.rolling(30, min_periods=15).std()
    avg_range = tr.rolling(60, min_periods=30).mean()
    stress = vol_range / avg_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = -stress.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_tail_range_vol_of_vol"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_tail_range_vol_of_vol"]
description: Tail-risk exposure is not only the level of volatility but the instability of the risk process itself. The volatility of true range measures how much daily price range fluctuates; a high vol-of-vol signals a fragile regime where stress can suddenly escalate. The negative sign reflects that such fragility tends to precede underperformance. This is a path-dependent stress-accumulation mechanism distinct from level-based volatility indicators.
